_comment: A three-question EXAMPLE of the format for db/tests/search_eval.ts. The real 30-question set goes in db/tests/search_eval.json.

questions.note: Convictions that impose a fine; GR 120/2022 and GR 310/2022 impose imprisonment only.
Bail granted or allowed; MISC 118/2025 (bail rejected) is not relevant. None of these orders contains the word 'released'.

questions.query: case thrown out because the complainant stopped coming to court
questions.note: Dismissals for default. Worded differently from the orders on purpose: a meaning match, not a word match.
